<!-- Thanks for contributing to git-a-profile. Delete the sections that don't apply. -->

## What is this?
- [ ] Sharing a forge (a profile I made)
- [ ] A new platform adapter
- [ ] A pipeline / docs improvement
- [ ] A fix

## If you're sharing a forge
- [ ] `runs/<handle>/REPORT.md` added (from `runs/_template/`)
- [ ] `assets/gallery/<handle>.png` added (~600px-wide hero crop)
- [ ] Live URL included and the page renders
- [ ] Real data only; no fabricated stats

## If you touched the pipeline
- [ ] `PRINCIPLES.md` still holds (nothing weakened)
- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/preflight.py <README>` on an example
